scenes.headline: How WorldCrafter remembers a place without rebuilding it
scenes.sub: No depth maps, no point clouds, no warping at inference.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ember! Walk a world model around and back, and the place has changed. This one remembers.

scenes.text: Instead of rebuilding the scene in 3D, pick past frames by coverage and let a view-synthesis encoder read them out at the camera's next poses.
scenes.say: Don't rebuild the scene. Pick good past frames, and let a view-synthesis encoder read them out from where you're headed.

left.title: Rebuild, then warp
items: Lift them into a point cloud
Warp the cloud into the next view
left.say: The usual fix rebuilds: depth, a point cloud, a warp. Only as good as its depth.

right.title: Encode, then read out
items: Pick past latent frames by coverage
right.say: WorldCrafter skips the cloud. It encodes a few past frames and asks what comes next.

steps.say: Every past frame is kept. Each chunk, retrieval picks the latest plus eight more.
An encoder borrowed from a view-synthesis model turns them into scene tokens. No point cloud.
Then the readout asks: what would the scene look like from the next four poses?
Four latent frames come back and fill the transformer's memory slot.
The chunk is denoised, added to the history, and the loop runs again.

scenes.title: The loop, in the paper's drawing

steps.say: The paper's own drawing: retrieved frames along the top, the camera path beneath.
The readout takes the current camera and feeds the transformer.

scenes.title: Retrieval picks for coverage

items.text: Mark what each past frame sees
items.say: Mark what each past frame sees.

items.text: Add whichever lifts the worst view
items.say: Add whichever frame lifts the worst view.

scenes.say: Not the most similar frames, which are near copies.

scenes.label: the memory slot in a 14,640-token window, whatever fills it
scenes.say: That slot is fixed. Fill it with raw frames, and revisit error nearly doubles.

scenes.title: Revisit LPIPS, lower is better
scenes.note: 725 videos on the authors' own benchmark
scenes.say: On the authors' benchmark, revisit error drops from point four eight seven, the best baseline, to point two five five.

scenes.text: 3D memory does not have to be a reconstruction. It has to answer: what should I see from here?
scenes.mark: what should I see from here?
scenes.say: 3D memory needn't be a reconstruction. It must answer: what should I see from here?

recap: Read out views where you go next
scenes.say: Pick by coverage, encode with a view-synthesis prior, read out where you go next.
